mapper.select: select last_event_seq from aden_workspace where workspace_id = #{workspaceId} and workspace_status = 'ACTIVE' for update
mapper.update: update aden_task_step s set s.step_state = 'CANCELED', s.finished_at = #{now}, s.version = s.version + 1, s.updated_at = #{now} where s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.step_state = 'READY' and exists (select 1 from aden_runner_delivery d where d.workspace_id=s.workspace_id and d.step_id=s.step_id and d.delivery_state='CANCELED')
